title: JSON 往返的类型坍缩：tuple/int 键/NaN/大整数精度
expected_output:
=== 会静默改变类型的往返 ===
  tuple        dumps=[1, 2]     loads=[1, 2]     type: tuple -> list
  int key      dumps={"1": "a"} loads={'1': 'a'} type: dict -> dict
  set          -> TypeError: Object of type set is not JSON serializable
  float -0.0   dumps=-0.0       loads=-0.0       type: float -> float

=== 往返不等价的断言 ===
原始: (1, {1: 'a'})
往返: [1, {'1': 'a'}]
相等吗? False
tuple 变 list, int 键变 str 键 —— 两处坍缩叠加

=== NaN / Infinity 是扩展语法 ===
dumps(nan)               = NaN
dumps(inf)               = Infinity
allow_nan=False -> ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant: nan
浏览器 JSON.parse('NaN') 会报错 —— 跨语言必须 allow_nan=False

=== 大整数精度边界 ===
原值           = 9007199254740993
dumps          = 9007199254740993
JS 侧会截断为  = 9007199254740992 (IEEE-754 double 无法表示 2^53+1)
安全做法: 序列化成字符串 -> "9007199254740993"

=== 结论 ===
JSON 不是无损格式; 写完立刻 loads 回来做 == 断言能暴露大部分坍缩
code:
import json

print("=== 会静默改变类型的往返 ===")
cases = [
    ("tuple", (1, 2)),
    ("int key", {1: 'a'}),
    ("set", None),
    ("float -0.0", -0.0),
]
for label, obj in cases:
    if label == "set":
        try:
            json.dumps({1, 2})
        except TypeError as e:
            print("  %-12s -> TypeError: %s" % (label, str(e)[:60]))
        continue
    s = json.dumps(obj)
    back = json.loads(s)
    print("  %-12s dumps=%-10s loads=%-10r type: %s -> %s"
          % (label, s, back, type(obj).__name__, type(back).__name__))

print()
print("=== 往返不等价的断言 ===")
orig = (1, {1: 'a'})
rt = json.loads(json.dumps(orig))
print("原始:", orig)
print("往返:", rt)
print("相等吗?", orig == rt)
print("tuple 变 list, int 键变 str 键 —— 两处坍缩叠加")

print()
print("=== NaN / Infinity 是扩展语法 ===")
print("dumps(nan)               =", json.dumps(float('nan')))
print("dumps(inf)               =", json.dumps(float('inf')))
try:
    json.dumps(float('nan'), allow_nan=False)
except ValueError as e:
    print("allow_nan=False -> ValueError:", e)
print("浏览器 JSON.parse('NaN') 会报错 —— 跨语言必须 allow_nan=False")

print()
print("=== 大整数精度边界 ===")
big = 9007199254740993  # 2^53 + 1
print("原值           =", big)
print("dumps          =", json.dumps(big))
print("JS 侧会截断为  = 9007199254740992 (IEEE-754 double 无法表示 2^53+1)")
print("安全做法: 序列化成字符串 ->", json.dumps(str(big)))

print()
print("=== 结论 ===")
print("JSON 不是无损格式; 写完立刻 loads 回来做 == 断言能暴露大部分坍缩")
